description: Pre-scaffolded code-reviewer self-persist findings sidecar. FRONTMATTER-BEARING as of v2.0.0 (docs/plans/2026-07-24-reviewer-sidecar-provisioning-reconciliation.md): coordinator-doc-new --type review-findings's self-scaffold fallback now emits the same frontmatter superset block as coordinator_core.subagent_sandbox.provision_report.py's provisioned (common) path -- status/agent_type/spawned_at/lead_session_id/divergence/commits/dispatch_feed -- so both producers are shape-identical and this schema no longer needs the retired match_mode:no-frontmatter special-case (that mode existed solely to suppress the missing-frontmatter warning for the old bare-prose shape, which no longer exists). required:[status] mirrors run-report.schema.json's own required set (the superset schema that also applies_to state/subagent-share/*/*.md) -- a review-findings file now satisfies BOTH schemas' required fields identically; this schema's applies_to glob stays the MORE SPECIFIC of the two (discriminated by the 'codereview-slice' filename token that only coordinator-doc-new's self-scaffold produces) so routing_strategy: most-specific-glob-wins (see artifact-shape-contract.schema.json) still resolves a review-findings file to THIS schema over the broader run-report one, without either schema rejecting it. Each self-scaffolded file is scoped to one code-reviewer dispatch (one review slice). The reviewer scaffolds its own sidecar here, replaces the FINDINGS sentinel with its full findings body via a single Edit, then returns a path pointer to the EM. The EM never absorbs the findings body into its own context. Lives at state/subagent-share/<session-id>/ -- the DR-091 one-home shared with every other typed subagent sidecar (run-report, staff-eng-review, assessment), not a review-findings-specific directory. Path formula (self-scaffold only): state/subagent-share/<session-id>/YYYY-MM-DD-codereview-slice<ID>-<SLUG>.md where <session-id> = the harness session id (coordinator-doc-new's _resolve_session_id(), sanitized), <ID> = --slice arg (alphanumeric + dashes, e.g. 'Z', 'A', '2a') and <SLUG> = sanitized --scope arg (comma-separated paths lowercased + non-alnum -> dash). Example: --slice Z --scope tests/x.py -> state/subagent-share/<session-id>/2026-06-30-codereview-sliceZ-tests-x-py.md. Sole self-scaffold producer: coordinator-doc-new --type review-findings --slice <id> --scope <comma-paths>. Registering this schema fires SCHEMAED-DOC-GENERATE-OBLIGATION for the self-scaffold path; the provisioned (common) path is produced by the engine, not this CLI. Do NOT write to state/subagent-share/ by hand. The FINDINGS sentinel (<!-- FINDINGS -->) is the anchor the reviewer replaces via a single Edit; note this sentinel text is distinct from provision_report.py's own review-findings template sentinel (a pre-existing, out-of-scope-here producer divergence). A surviving sentinel after review indicates a no-op or an aborted write. Distinct from state/review-trail/*.json (JSON trail records, produced by coordinator-write-review-trail.sh) -- this schema governs the markdown findings body only. Spec backlink: cross-repo/inbox/2026-07-01-reviewer-selfpersist-confinement-redirect.md. Spec backlink (subagent-share migration + frontmatter unification): docs/plans/2026-07-24-reviewer-sidecar-provisioning-reconciliation.md
